en: Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling that is a root-cause (hetu), there arises a state not associated with pleasant feeling and not a root-cause, by way of root-condition (hetupaccaya).
Dependent on a state not a root-cause but associated with pleasant feeling, there arises a state not a root-cause and not associated with pleasant feeling, by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling that is a root-cause and a state associated with pleasant feeling that is not a root-cause, there arises a state not associated with pleasant feeling that is not a root-cause, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. There are three [answers] for root;
three for object ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
(The "Conascent" section ... pe ... and the "Investigation" section should also be expanded.)

Dependent on a state associated with painful feeling that is a root-cause (*hetu*), there arises a state not associated with painful feeling that is not a root-cause, by way of root-condition (*hetupaccaya*). (Abbreviated.
Under root [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are three. (Full detail for all.

Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is a root-cause, there arises a state not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is not a root-cause, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, three; ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance, three. (The full detail applies everywhere.)
